snippet.title: Color Breakers 2 | The friendship ruining game | Available NOW on Nintendo Switch and Steam!
snippet.description:
Color Breakers 2 is an upcoming chaotic 1-8 player local and online multiplayer co-op coloring game where players need to work together in each of the levels to complete as many paintings as possible. The paintings in each level are procedurally generated which guarantee a unique experience every time you play. Collaborate as a team to succeed or get ready to ruin your friendships!

The game is available NOW on Nintendo Switch and Steam!
